meta.title: Update build documentation with quick build optimization flags
meta.body_summary: Add documentation for QUICK_REBUILD, QUICK_REBUILD_TOOLCHAIN, and QUICK_REBUILD_PACKAGES flags to the Azure Linux build docs, claiming significant build performance improvements.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot updated build docs with quick rebuild flags; maintainer requested Diátaxis restructuring and detailed review; PR closed without merge despite iteration.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 671 changed lines across 4 documentation files, this is a medium-sized documentation update. It fits a documentation-driven performance PR, which was closed without merging after the maintainer requested a more thorough Diátaxis-based restructuring.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer dmcilvaney provided a detailed review using the Diátaxis framework, requesting restructuring of the quick build optimization guide to include Tutorials, How-To Guides, Reference, and Explanation sections, referencing PR #5218.
review_details.performance_claim: QUICK_REBUILD flags can significantly improve build performance by using published components, enabling delta builds, and caching dependencies.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed without merge after maintainer requested extensive documentation restructuring; no explicit rejection but lack of final approval indicates possible insufficient changes.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent produced documentation updates for build flags, but maintainer required a detailed Diátaxis-guided restructuring; the agent iterated but could not achieve merge.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer dmcilvaney read the updated documentation and compared it against reference PR #5218, identifying gaps in tutorials, how-to guides, and reference material.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Documentation-only PR; no benchmark or profiling evidence for the claimed build performance improvement.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge; no further action after maintainer's restructuring request.

core_change_summary.description: Updated building.md and added dedicated guides (quick_build_optimization.md, build_images.md, build_packages.md) to document QUICK_REBUILD flags; restructured using Diátaxis framework after maintainer feedback.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Two additional guides were added for package and image building, also referencing the optimization flags.
